data.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

Implement backfill-bug-types.sh. Make tests/scripts/test-backfill-bug-types.sh pass.

## Behavior
- Filter: ticket list --type=bug --status=closed; filter to those closed within 60 days (use ticket created_at or a timestamp field)
- Skip tickets already carrying any bug-type-* tag (idempotent)
- Skip jira-* ticket IDs (log skip, don't attempt classification)
- For each qualifying ticket: dispatch bug-classifier-haiku via Agent tool guidance in SKILL.md pattern; apply tag via ticket tag CLI
- Failure fallback: same as S2 (bug-type-uncategorized + bug-type-classifier-failed-<reason>)
- Lock: create .claude/locks/ dir if missing; lock file contains PID + ISO-8601 timestamp; trap EXIT to remove
- --dry-run: print tickets that WOULD be classified, don't dispatch or tag
- Respect TICKET_CMD env var for testability

## Done when
bash tests/scripts/test-backfill-bug-types.sh exits 0.
